title: Run the upload hub overnight
purpose: Every phone here tonight is counted, uploaded, and back cleared before 7:00 AM.
with: the runner, who counts and signs with you
when: Every night, evening to 11 PM. Thursday night is the full flush.

steps.do: Get the room ready before the first run.
steps.check: Router on the UPS, a cable per phone.

steps.do: Count each case against its manifest and sign.
steps.detail: Count phones, not the number written.
steps.check: Every ID ticked, both signatures, the time in.

steps.do: Dock every phone, one per cable.
steps.check: Every phone charging, its upload moving.

steps.do: Walk the racks and fix stuck phones.
steps.detail: Another cable, port, the hub's line, one restart.
steps.check: Each stuck phone is fixed or held.

steps.do: Check every run is in by 11 PM.
steps.check: All runs in, or Moharam knows which is missing.

steps.do: Repack cleared phones by site with new manifests.
steps.detail: Cleared means zero pending on the dashboard, not the collection app.
steps.check: At most a third of a site's phones per case.

steps.do: Hand each case to the runner and sign.
steps.check: Both signatures, time out, case locked.

steps.do: Report the night, then lock up.
steps.detail: Portfolio Managers get their held IDs and why. Mano gets TB moved, devices cleared, devices held.

done: Every phone is back cleared, or held and its Portfolio Manager told.

fails.if: Count and manifest do not match
fails.then: Recount by ID. Sign for what you counted. Call Moharam now. Lost mode within the hour.

fails.if: A phone still will not upload
fails.then: Hold it. It leaves empty or not at all. Tell its Portfolio Manager tonight. A second night is an incident.

fails.if: Many uploads stop, or the line goes down
fails.then: Restart the router and switch once. Still down, call Mano now. Moharam sends runs to the second hub.

fails.if: The runner comes and phones are still uploading
fails.then: Hold them. Two nights in a row, the hub is over capacity: tell Mano.

escalate: Line or hub: Mano, now. Run, runner, or count: Moharam, now.
